guards: The same analyte appears here alone and as one row of lab-lipid-panel-multi, at a different value. The quote prints LDL where the result names LDL Cholesterol, an abbreviation in the reviewed table, so the result stays unchecked rather than unlocatable - pinned so that the table losing that entry is a deliberate change.
